name: Subset-Sum Capacity Obfuscation
description: Replaced the explicit matrix determinant with a subset-sum formula over the 8 subsets of the triplet. The formula evaluates to 18 if and only if the triplet forms a triangle. Models that pattern-match will blindly implement the $O(n^3)$ subset-sum, leading to a Time Limit Exceeded, while reasoning models will evaluate the formula, deduce the triangle equivalence, and use an efficient graph algorithm.
